abstract: We estimate the impact of public pension incentives on labor supply far from the normal retirement age by exploiting Poland's switch from a Defined Benefit to a Notional Defined Contribution (NDC) scheme. This reform created a sharp cohort-based discontinuity in the link between current pension contributions and future benefits. Using this discontinuity and the universe of taxpayers, we estimate an employment elasticity with respect to the net return to work of 0.51 for men at ages 51-54. We estimate a lifecycle model to match these responses and discuss the broader implications of the reform. The shift to NDC reallocates work incentives over the lifecycle, strengthening incentives at younger ages, when labor supply is relatively inelastic, and weakening them at older ages, when labor supply is more elastic. This reallocation of work incentives tends to reduce aggregate lifecycle labor supply, which highlights the advantage of targeting pension incentives towards ages at which labor supply is most responsive.

abstract: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening. Among Pareto-efficient menus, the certifier’s profit-maximising menu provides maximal soft information while restricting hard information provision. The two channels diverge because screening creates value the certifier can fully capture, whereas hard information amplifies costly information rents. Using power value functions, we derive comparative statics showing that information restrictions target low-quality sellers when information value is moderate, but high-quality sellers receive perfect quality revelation when information value is high.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在卖方拥有产品质量部分私人信息的市场中垄断性认证问题。认证机构可通过两种渠道提供信息：筛选卖方的私人信息（软信息）以及获取新的质量数据（硬信息）。我们证明，任何未能实现最大程度筛选的认证菜单，均会被完全筛选的认证菜单帕累托占优。
title: Informative Certification: Screening vs. Acquisition

abstract_zh: 我们利用一个独特的自然实验，考察了银行监管对银行风险承担的影响。该实验基于印度储备银行（RBI）对银行分支网络扩张的监管审批，这些审批因政治关联而具有外生性。研究发现，获得监管批准以扩张分支网络的银行，其风险承担水平显著上升。这一效应在资本充足率较低、盈利能力较弱以及治理结构较差的银行中更为明显。进一步分析表明，风险承担的增加源于银行对风险资产的配置倾斜，而非资产规模的扩张。我们的研究为监管审批在塑造银行风险行为中的作用提供了新的证据，并对金融监管政策具有重要启示。

abstract: Norm nudging interventions seek to influence behavior by shaping what individuals expect others to do ( empirical expectations ) or regard as appropriate ( normative expectations ). We study how such interventions operate in an anonymous anti-coordination problem, using an online El Farol Bar Game experiment composed of two studies. Study 1 elicits social expectations (empirical and normative) and personal normative beliefs before subjects make their decision in the El Farol Bar Game. Study 2 implements norm nudges by providing participants with pre-decision messages based on the social expectations elicited in Study 1. Results show that subjects conform not only to their empirical expectations, but also to their personal normative beliefs. Normative expectations exert weaker and less consistent effects. Moreover, norm nudging interventions primarily induce prudence by reducing behavior that jeopardizes social welfare.
abstract_zh: 规范助推干预旨在通过塑造个体对他人行为（经验预期）或社会认可行为（规范预期）的认知来影响其行为。我们通过一项由两项研究组成的在线“艾尔法罗尔酒吧博弈”实验，探讨此类干预在匿名反协调问题中的作用。研究一在受试者于艾尔法罗尔酒吧博弈中做出决策前，引出其社会预期（经验性与规范性）及个人规范信念。研究二则基于研究一中引出的社会预期，向参与者提供决策前信息，实施规范助推。结果表明，受试者不仅遵循其经验预期，还遵循其个人规范信念。规范性预期的影响较弱且不一致。此外，规范助推干预主要通过减少损害社会福利的行为来诱导谨慎行事。

abstract: The USDA's Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) delivers environmental benefits to society by enrolling cropland and grasslands to reestablish or safeguard long‐term vegetative cover. In recent years, the CRP has dramatically increased grassland enrollment while cropland enrollment has been in steady decline. This paper uses descriptive analysis, multivariate regression analysis, and a spatial comparison of participant incentives to assess the relationship between these two CRP signup types. We argue that while these two programs do not compete administratively under current trends, these enrollment patterns could tighten competition between the programs in future periods if total enrollment approaches a shared cap.
abstract_zh: 美国农业部保护储备计划（CRP）通过将农田和草地纳入计划以重建或保护长期植被覆盖，为社会带来环境效益。近年来，CRP的草地纳入面积大幅增加，而农田纳入面积持续下降。本文采用描述性分析、多元回归分析以及参与者激励的空间比较，评估这两种CRP签约类型之间的关系。我们认为，尽管在当前趋势下这两个计划在行政管理上并不存在竞争，但如果总纳入面积接近共同上限，这些纳入模式可能会在未来阶段加剧计划间的竞争。
title: Complementary or Competitive? Emerging Interactions Between Restoration and Protection in the Conservation Reserve Program
title_zh: 互补还是竞争？保护储备计划中恢复与保护之间的新兴互动

abstract: Fuel subsidies in resource‐rich economies distort consumption and undermine fiscal efficiency. This study exploits Kuwait's 2016 gasoline (petrol) price reform—which raised prices by up to 83% after nearly two decades of price stability—to estimate short‐run price elasticity and analyse consumer behavioural responses under entrenched subsidies. Using high‐frequency, station‐level daily gasoline sales data and traffic data combined with Regression Discontinuity in Time (RDiT) designs, the study causally identifies the reform's impact on gasoline demand. Mechanism analyses evaluate substitution across octane grades, driving behaviour, public transport use and extensive‐margin responses such as vehicle ownership or efficiency. Contrary to the literature documenting limited price responsiveness in subsidy‐heavy rentier states, the reform produced a sharp and immediate drop in fuel consumption, with a short‐run price elasticity of approximately −0.45. The dominant response was intra‐product substitution, as consumers persistently shifted from octane 95 to 91. Driving reductions were modest; public transit use and extensive‐margin adjustments were negligible. High‐octane (98) users showed near‐zero responsiveness. By raising prices, the reform likely reduced the estimated KD 7 million (US$24 million) in pre‐reform waste as drivers switched to suitable, cheaper fuel. The reform also reduced deadweight loss by over KD 55 million (US$179 million) annually, with total welfare gains—accounting for externalities—reaching up to KD 97 million (US$312 million) annually. This study shows price reforms in rentier states can yield substantial efficiency and welfare gains, but require complementary policies to address informational frictions and limited substitution options.
abstract_zh: 资源丰富经济体的燃料补贴扭曲了消费并削弱了财政效率。本研究利用科威特2016年汽油价格改革——在近二十年价格稳定后，汽油价格最高上涨83%——来估计短期价格弹性，并分析在根深蒂固的补贴制度下消费者的行为反应。通过使用高频、加油站层面的日度汽油销售数据和交通数据，结合时间断点回归设计，本研究因果识别了改革对汽油需求的影响。机制分析评估了辛烷值等级间的替代、驾驶行为、公共交通使用以及车辆拥有率或效率等广延边际反应。与记录补贴密集型食利国家价格反应有限的文献相反，改革导致了燃料消费的急剧和即时下降，短期价格弹性约为-0.45。主要反应是产品内替代，消费者持续从95辛烷值转向91辛烷值。驾驶减少幅度较小；公共交通使用和广延边际调整可忽略不计。高辛烷值（98）用户表现出近乎零的反应。通过提高价格，改革可能减少了改革前估计的700万科威特第纳尔（2400万美元）的浪费，因为驾驶者转向了合适且更便宜的燃料。改革还每年减少了超过5500万科威特第纳尔（1.79亿美元）的无谓损失，考虑外部性后的总福利收益每年高达9700万科威特第纳尔（3.12亿美元）。本研究表明，食利国家的价格改革可以产生显著的效率和福利收益，但需要补充政策来解决信息摩擦和有限的替代选择。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: How Drivers in a Rentier State Respond to Fuel Price Shocks: High‐Frequency Evidence From Kuwait's Subsidy Reform
title_zh: 租金国家司机如何应对燃油价格冲击：科威特补贴改革的高频证据

abstract: Americans across the country are plagued with harmful effects from air and water pollution, resource depletion, land degradation, biodiversity loss and climate change. Protecting the natural environment, ecosystems and humans from these effects will demand substantive changes in production methods, delivery processes and consumption patterns. Amassing resources to effect such changes will likely require both higher taxes and prices. Currently, the literature offers little in the way of estimating or identifying the factors important in determining the public's willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices, in principle, for environmental protection. This paper is a first attempt to fill this gap. Using data from the United States 2021 General Social Survey, we estimate a bivariate ordered probit model, enabling us to calculate average marginal effects on and average predicted probabilities of the willingness to pay both higher taxes and higher prices to protect the environment. Without considerable and widespread changes in attitudes and beliefs, results suggest that there is little chance that a majority of Americans will support higher prices, a smaller chance of a majority supporting higher taxes and a still smaller chance that a majority will support both higher taxes and higher prices for environmental protection.
abstract_zh: 全美各地民众正遭受空气与水污染、资源枯竭、土地退化、生物多样性丧失及气候变化带来的有害影响。保护自然环境、生态系统及人类免受这些影响，需要生产方式、配送流程和消费模式发生实质性变革。为促成此类变革而筹集资源，很可能需要提高税收和价格。目前，学术界在估算或识别决定公众原则上是否愿意为环境保护同时承担更高税收与更高价格的关键因素方面，几乎未提供任何研究。本文首次尝试填补这一空白。利用美国2021年综合社会调查数据，我们估计了双变量有序概率模型，从而能够计算公众为保护环境同时承担更高税收与更高价格的意愿的平均边际效应和平均预测概率。研究结果表明，若态度与信念未发生广泛且显著的转变，大多数美国人支持更高价格的可能性微乎其微，支持更高税收的可能性更小，而同时支持为环境保护承担更高税收与更高价格的可能性则微乎其微。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: What Is the Probability That the Environmentally Conscious Are Willing to Pay Higher Taxes and Higher Prices to Protect the Environment? Recent Evidence for the United States
title_zh: 环保意识者愿意支付更高税收和价格以保护环境的概率是多少？——来自美国的最新证据

abstract: This paper empirically investigates the impact of the digital economy on firms’ low-carbon transition, using data on listed firms in the Chinese A-share market from 2013 to 2022. Our findings reveal that the digital economy notably drives their low-carbon transition, and this conclusion remains robust to stability tests and controls for endogeneity. The mediating effect test outcomes indicate that the digital economy can facilitate firms’ transition to low-carbon operations through industrial structure upgrading. The moderating effect analysis exhibits that the intensity of market competition strengthens this facilitating effect on firms’ low-carbon transition. The heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that this facilitating effect is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, declining firms, digital economy firms, and technology-intensive enterprises. Furthermore, the spillover effect test results indicate significant spillover effects of the digital economy among peer firms, categorized by industry and city. Our study elaborates on the underlying mediating pathways through which the digital economy indirectly drives this transition via industrial structure upgrading, alongside the moderating role of market competition intensity. This work broadens the theoretical research framework on transformation dynamics and provides decision-making references for formulating industrial upgrading guidance policies and optimizing the market competition landscape. abstract_zh: 本文利用2013—2022年中国A股市场上市公司数据，实证考察了数字经济对企业低碳转型的影响。研究发现，数字经济显著推动了企业低碳转型，该结论在稳定性检验和内生性控制后依然稳健。中介效应检验结果表明，数字经济能够通过产业结构升级促进企业低碳转型。调节效应分析显示，市场竞争强度强化了这一促进效应。异质性分析表明，该促进效应在国有企业、衰退型企业、数字经济企业及技术密集型企业中更为显著。此外，溢出效应检验结果显示，数字经济在同行业、同城市的企业间存在显著的空间溢出效应。本研究揭示了数字经济通过产业结构升级间接驱动企业低碳转型的中介路径，以及市场竞争强度的调节作用，拓展了转型动因的理论研究框架，并为制定产业升级引导政策、优化市场竞争格局提供了决策参考。关键词：数字经济；企业低碳转型；产业结构升级；市场竞争强度 JEL分类号：F63 F61 L23 Q50 致谢：感谢国家社会科学基金西部项目[24XGL001]、甘肃省高等学校教师创新基金项目[2024B-092]及甘肃省高等学校教师创新基金项目[2025A-076]的资助。

abstract: Tax incentive policies are widely used to foster green innovation, but their supply-chain spillovers remain underexamined. This paper explores the impact of upstream and downstream firms’ tax incentives on midstream enterprises’ green innovation using China’s National Enterprise Tax Survey Data and listed firm data spanning 2008–2016. Baseline estimates indicate that downstream tax-incentive exposure is positively and statistically significantly associated with midstream green innovation, whereas no robust statistically significant association is found for upstream exposure. Innovation-composition tests further show that downstream exposure is associated with more green patent applications, a higher green share, fewer non-green patent applications, and no statistically significant change in total patent applications, indicating a green-oriented reallocation rather than a general expansion of innovation. On this basis, this paper further takes China’s 2014 Accelerated Depreciation Policy for Fixed Assets as a quasi-natural experiment and applies the Double Machine Learning (DML) method to provide policy-based identification evidence on tax incentives and supply-chain green innovation spillovers. Mechanism analysis provides evidence consistent with liquidity, corporate-vitality, and ESG-related channels. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the downstream coefficient is larger and statistically significant among midstream enterprises facing stricter environmental regulation, employing executives with environmental backgrounds, or receiving greater media attention. abstract_zh: 税收激励政策被广泛用于促进绿色创新，但其供应链溢出效应尚未得到充分研究。本文利用2008-2016年中国全国企业税收调查数据和上市公司数据，探讨上下游企业税收激励对中游企业绿色创新的影响。基准估计表明，下游税收激励暴露与中游绿色创新呈正向且统计显著的相关关系，而上游暴露则未发现稳健的统计显著关联。创新构成检验进一步显示，下游暴露与更多绿色专利申请、更高绿色占比、更少非绿色专利申请相关，而专利申请总量无统计显著变化，表明这是一种绿色导向的重新配置而非创新的普遍扩张。在此基础上，本文进一步以中国2014年固定资产加速折旧政策为准自然实验，采用双机器学习方法，为税收激励与供应链绿色创新溢出提供基于政策的识别证据。机制分析提供了与流动性、企业活力及ESG相关渠道一致的证据。异质性分析表明，在面临更严格环境规制、拥有环境背景高管或受到更多媒体关注的中游企业中，下游系数更大且统计显著。关键词：减税激励 供应链溢出 绿色创新 双机器学习 JEL分类：H23 Q55 O38

abstract: We introduce EA‐MD‐QD, a new publicly available dataset comprising 1136 macroeconomic time series for the euro area (EA) and its ten largest member countries observed at monthly or quarterly frequency. Since January 2024, EA‐MD‐QD has been updated monthly and continuously revised, providing a valuable resource for policy analysis in the EA. Using EA‐MD‐QD, we study country‐specific impulse responses to an EA‐wide monetary policy shock. Results reveal moderate yet significant cross‐country heterogeneity, with differences between so‐called core countries, such as France and Germany, and peripheral countries, such as Italy and Spain, in their price and interest rate responses, together with meaningful differences in real activity, while stock price responses are relatively homogeneous. Evidence points to homeownership and saving behavior as potential drivers of the observed cross‐country differences.
abstract_zh: 我们推出EA-MD-QD，这是一个新的公开数据集，包含欧元区及其十个最大成员国的1136个月度或季度宏观经济时间序列。自2024年1月起，EA-MD-QD每月更新并持续修订，为欧元区政策分析提供了宝贵资源。利用EA-MD-QD，我们研究了各国对欧元区整体货币政策冲击的特定脉冲响应。结果显示，各国之间存在适度但显著的异质性：法国和德国等所谓核心国家与意大利和西班牙等外围国家在价格和利率响应上存在差异，实际经济活动方面也有显著不同，而股票价格响应则相对同质。证据表明，住房拥有率和储蓄行为是观察到的跨国差异的潜在驱动因素。
title: Large Datasets for the Euro Area and Its Member Countries and the Dynamic Effects of the Common Monetary Policy

abstract: Interest rate spreads vary widely across time and countries and are a central driver of business cycles in emerging market economies (EMEs). Since 2008, advanced market economies (AMEs) have exhibited persistently higher and more volatile spreads, alongside increased macroeconomic volatility and stronger co-movement with EMEs. We document six facts showing that AMEs have become more similar to EMEs along key dimensions. We interpret these patterns through a small open economy model and uncover a stark dichotomy: higher spreads reflect greater indebtedness and lower debt tolerance, whereas greater macroeconomic volatility and co-movement are driven by stronger global shocks.
abstract_zh: 利率利差在不同时期和国家间差异显著，是新兴市场经济体（EMEs）商业周期的主要驱动力。自2008年以来，发达市场经济体（AMEs）表现出持续更高且更波动的利差，同时伴随宏观经济波动性增强以及与EMEs的联动性加强。我们记录了六项事实，表明AMEs在关键维度上已与EMEs更加相似。我们通过一个小型开放经济模型解释这些模式，并揭示了一个鲜明的二分法：更高的利差反映了更高的债务水平和较低的债务容忍度，而更大的宏观经济波动性和联动性则是由更强的全球冲击所驱动。
title: Different no more: Country spreads in advanced and emerging economies
title_zh: 不再不同：发达与新兴经济体的国家利差

abstract: We show how probate inventories can be used to measure the seasonal pattern of grain stocks and hence provide direct information on both intra-year and inter-year storage (“carryover”). The correct procedure to quantify total carryover is a ratio-of-means statistic that consistently estimates the appropriate weighted average of individual carryover decisions. Using an existing data base of inventories, we show that the seasonal pattern is plausible, robust to alternative specifications and consistent with an alternative way of estimating carryover. We find that average carryover in the period 1600-1750 was very low in Kent and virtually zero in Cornwall.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用遗嘱认证清单来衡量谷物库存的季节性模式，从而直接提供年内和跨年储存（“结转”）的信息。量化总结转的正确方法是采用均值比统计量，该统计量能一致地估计个体结转决策的适当加权平均值。利用现有的清单数据库，我们表明季节性模式是合理的，对替代规格具有稳健性，并与估算结转的另一种方法相一致。我们发现，在1600年至1750年间，肯特郡的平均结转量非常低，而康沃尔郡几乎为零。
title: Estimating grain storage with probate inventories: Kent and Cornwall, 1600-1750
title_zh: 利用遗嘱清单估算粮食储存量：肯特郡与康沃尔郡，1600-1750年

abstract: This paper asks what can be learned from observed merger pairings when acquirers and targets meet in a two-sided market with transferable utility. A compact assignment-game model implies revealed-preference inequalities: observed matches must generate at least as much total surplus as feasible counterfactual matches in the same local market. I take these inequalities to Refinitiv M&A data for U.S. same-industry transactions during 2010–2024. The final estimation sample contains 1025 completed acquirer-target pairs and 36,881 financially feasible counterfactual pairs constructed within industry-quarter cells. A benchmark linear surplus specification based on differences in profitability, leverage, sales growth, and liquidity has weak identifying content. Across 60 optimization runs, the same maximum score is obtained, but the coefficient vectors attaining it differ substantially in sign and magnitude. The result is not a general impossibility claim about revealed-preference methods. It shows that observed matches and standard financial differences alone provide limited discipline on merger surplus when transfers, outside options, and richer pair-specific synergies are unobserved.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨在具有可转移效用的双边市场中，当收购方与目标方相遇时，从观察到的并购配对中能获得何种信息。一个紧凑的指派博弈模型揭示了显示性偏好不等式：观察到的配对必须至少产生与同一局部市场中可行的反事实配对相等的总剩余。我将这些不等式应用于2010-2024年美国同行业交易的Refinitiv并购数据。最终估计样本包含1025个已完成的收购方-目标方配对，以及在行业-季度单元内构建的36881个财务上可行的反事实配对。基于盈利能力、杠杆率、销售增长率和流动性差异的基准线性剩余设定，其识别能力较弱。在60次优化运行中，虽获得相同的最大得分，但达到该得分的系数向量在符号和大小上存在显著差异。这一结果并非对显示性偏好方法的普遍不可行性论断。它表明，当转移支付、外部选择以及更丰富的配对特定协同效应未被观测到时，仅凭观察到的配对和标准财务差异对并购剩余的约束作用有限。
title: Learning from observed matches in two-sided markets
title_zh: 从双边市场中的观测匹配中学习

abstract: Reduced-form bequest motives are routinely assumed to exhibit decreasing absolute risk aversion (DARA). I show this is consistent with an underlying altruistic primitive: when descendant risk is unrealised at the bequest choice date, DARA of the warm-glow preference is inherited from the descendant’s continuation value under both multiplicative and additive risk, without parametric restriction. Yet the two canonical specifications differ in what is preserved beyond DARA. Multiplicative risk yields a shifter-weight decomposition and preserves CRRA form; additive income risk—the relevant case for dynastic precautionary savings—preserves DARA but not functional form. • Warm-glow bequest motives inherit DARA from the descendant’s continuation value. • Holds under additive and multiplicative risk without parametric restriction. • Differences across calibrated studies need not reflect altruism strength. • Multiplicative risk preserves CRRA functional form; additive income risk does not. • Under additive risk, functional form is not disciplined by the altruistic primitive.
abstract_zh: 简化形式的遗赠动机通常被假定表现出递减绝对风险厌恶（DARA）。我证明这与潜在的利他主义原始设定相一致：当后代风险在遗赠选择日期尚未实现时，暖光偏好的DARA特性是从后代的延续价值中继承而来的，无论是在乘法风险还是加法风险下，均无需参数限制。然而，两种典型设定在DARA之外所保留的特性上存在差异。乘法风险产生了一种移位权重分解，并保留了CRRA形式；加法收入风险——与王朝预防性储蓄相关的情形——保留了DARA但未保留函数形式。• 暖光遗赠动机从后代的延续价值中继承DARA。• 在加法和乘法风险下均成立，无需参数限制。• 校准研究间的差异未必反映利他主义强度。• 乘法风险保留CRRA函数形式；加法收入风险则不保留。• 在加法风险下，函数形式不受利他主义原始设定的约束。
title: Warm-glow bequests and descendant risk
title_zh: 温暖遗赠与后代风险

abstract: In this paper, we examine whether the relationship between non-bank financial intermediation (NBFI) and economic growth varies across the economic cycle. While existing studies focus on the average effects of broad measures of NBFI, the effects of the narrow measure of NBFI differing during periods of economic stress is less clear. Using a panel of 26 jurisdictions participating in the Financial Stability Board's NBFI exercise between 2006 and 2024, we find that larger narrow NBFI sectors are associated with higher real GDP growth. However, we find limited evidence that this relationship varies systematically between expansionary and recessionary periods.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了非银行金融中介（NBFI）与经济增长之间的关系是否随经济周期变化。现有研究侧重于广义NBFI指标的平均效应，而狭义NBFI指标在经济压力时期的影响尚不明确。利用2006年至2024年间参与金融稳定理事会NBFI监测的26个司法管辖区的面板数据，我们发现，狭义NBFI部门规模越大，实际GDP增长率越高。然而，我们发现的证据有限，表明这种关系在扩张期与衰退期之间存在系统性差异。
title: Narrow Non-Bank Financial Intermediation and Economic Growth: Does the Economic Cycle Matter?
title_zh: 狭义的影子银行中介与经济增长：经济周期是否重要？

abstract: We study the robustness of Nash equilibria in the preference revelation game induced by the student-optimal stable mechanism when small application fees are introduced. Assuming lexicographic preferences over outcomes, we show that introducing application fees reduces the set of Nash equilibria, to the detriment of student welfare. We provide a sufficient condition on the distribution of application fees that eliminates any Pareto improvement in which a student strictly benefits from being assigned to a given school. When all application fees are strictly positive for all applications, every Nash equilibrium induces a stable assignment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在引入小额申请费的情况下，由学生最优稳定机制引发的偏好揭示博弈中纳什均衡的稳健性。假设对结果具有字典序偏好，我们表明引入申请费会减少纳什均衡的集合，从而损害学生福利。我们提供了申请费分布的一个充分条件，该条件消除了任何帕累托改进，其中学生因被分配到特定学校而严格受益。当所有申请费对所有申请均为严格正数时，每个纳什均衡都会产生一个稳定分配。
title: Application fees and the robustness of Nash equilibria in school choice
title_zh: 申请费与学校选择中纳什均衡的稳健性

abstract: We study the labor-market effects of brand capital, a demand-side intangible asset that differentiates firms' products. Brand capital is difficult to study because its investments are typically unobserved. We leverage firm-to-firm trademark transfers, which create discrete changes in the ownership of legal rights over established brands. We link the universe of Italian trademark transfers to firm financial statements and matched employer-employee records, allowing us to document how acquiring brand capital affects firm scale, pay, labor composition, and labor shares. In a matched event-study design, trademark acquisitions raise intangible assets by 19%, sales by 8%, and employment by 6%, while leaving average weekly earnings unchanged. Since sales rise more than the wage bill, acquirers' labor shares fall. Employment gains are concentrated in market-facing work, as marketing and sales employment rises roughly twice as much as other employment. More generally, employment growth is concentrated among white-collar and managerial workers. Combining buyers and sellers, trademark transfers increase total sales and employment among transacting firms, and lower their combined labor share. Brand capital thus leads to firms' expansion, shifts labor demand toward market-facing tasks, and provides a micro-level channel through which demand-side intangible capital can lower labor shares.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌资本（一种使企业产品差异化的需求侧无形资产）对劳动力市场的影响。由于品牌资本的投资通常难以观测，相关研究面临困难。我们利用企业间的商标转让——这一行为会导致既有品牌法律所有权的离散变化——将意大利商标转让的完整数据与企业财务报表及匹配的雇主-雇员记录相链接，从而揭示收购品牌资本如何影响企业规模、薪酬、劳动力构成及劳动份额。在匹配事件研究设计中，商标收购使无形资产增加19%，销售额增长8%，就业人数上升6%，而周平均工资保持不变。由于销售额增幅超过工资总额，收购方的劳动份额下降。就业增长集中于面向市场的工作岗位，营销与销售岗位的就业增幅约为其他岗位的两倍。更广泛而言，就业增长集中在白领及管理人员群体。综合买卖双方来看，商标转让提高了交易企业的总销售额与就业人数，并降低了其合并劳动份额。因此，品牌资本推动企业扩张，将劳动力需求转向面向市场的任务，并为需求侧无形资产降低劳动份额提供了微观层面的传导渠道。
title: The Labor Demand Implications of Brand Capital: Evidence from Trademark Transactions
title_zh: 品牌资本的劳动力需求含义：来自商标交易的证据

abstract: How do global production networks and market structure interact to shape the gains from trade and competition policy? We develop a quantifiable model with two-sided firm heterogeneity, matching frictions, and imperfect competition. More productive buyers match with more suppliers, which spurs tougher competition, lowers input costs, and raises profits. Reduced-form evidence confirms that larger French and Chilean firms import higher quantities at lower prices as more Chinese suppliers enter, and that suppliers charge diversified buyers lower markups. We estimate the model by extending recent methods for combinatorial discrete-choice problems. Counterfactuals reveal that entry upstream benefits primarily high-productivity buyers, while lower trade or matching costs favor mid-productivity firms. Moreover, the interaction between endogenous networks and markups significantly amplifies the welfare gains from entry upstream, as well as from packaging trade liberalization with reductions in matching or entry costs.
abstract_zh: 全球生产网络与市场结构如何相互作用，以塑造贸易收益与竞争政策？我们构建了一个可量化的模型，包含双边企业异质性、匹配摩擦和不完全竞争。生产率更高的买家与更多供应商匹配，这促进了更激烈的竞争，降低了投入成本，并提高了利润。简化形式的证据证实，随着更多中国供应商进入，较大的法国和智利企业以更低价格进口更多数量，且供应商对多元化买家收取较低的加成。我们通过扩展组合离散选择问题的最新方法对模型进行估计。反事实分析显示，上游进入主要惠及高生产率买家，而降低贸易或匹配成本则有利于中等生产率企业。此外，内生网络与加成之间的相互作用显著放大了上游进入带来的福利收益，以及将贸易自由化与匹配或进入成本降低相结合所带来的福利收益。
china_relevance_reason: 研究主题为全球生产网络与不完全竞争的理论模型，虽使用中国供应商数据作为实证佐证，但核心研究对象、制度背景及政策应用并非中国，中国仅作为数据来源之一。
title: Global production networks and imperfect competition
title_zh: 全球生产网络与不完全竞争

abstract: Using monthly bilateral trade data for 50 countries at the HTS-10 product level, this paper finds that foreign exporters absorbed 40-50 percent of the tariff increases, consistent with optimal tariff theory. Absorption was highly unequal: dominant exporters absorbed 50–65 percent of the tariff shock through lower export prices, while smaller suppliers passed through most or all of the tariff. The results differ from previous studies finding near-complete pass-through for the 2025 tariff shock because of asymmetrical treatment of suppliers. Other studies evaluate whether the typical trade partner absorbed tariffs—it did not. But given trade is highly skewed, with the top exporting country in a product accounting for nearly 50 percent of trade on average, and the top 1 percent of products accounting for over 50 percent of trade, the focus here is on aggregate effects. Provided the largest suppliers are absorbing tariffs, consumer prices will rise by less. The results are robust to a wide range of controls.
abstract_zh: 本文利用50个国家在HTS-10产品层面的月度双边贸易数据，发现外国出口商吸收了40%-50%的关税增长，这与最优关税理论一致。吸收程度高度不均：主导出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了50%-65%的关税冲击，而较小供应商则转嫁了大部分或全部关税。这一结果与先前研究发现2025年关税冲击近乎完全转嫁的结论不同，原因在于对供应商的非对称处理。其他研究评估了典型贸易伙伴是否吸收关税——结论是否定的。但由于贸易高度倾斜，产品层面最大出口国平均占贸易额近50%，且前1%的产品占贸易额超过50%，本文聚焦于总体效应。只要最大供应商吸收关税，消费者价格涨幅就会更小。该结果在广泛的控制变量下依然稳健。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为多国贸易数据，未涉及中国、中国企业或中国政策背景。
title: Tariff Incidence and Market Power: Evidence from the 2025 US Tariff Shock
title_zh: 关税归宿与市场势力：来自2025年美国关税冲击的证据

abstract: Since the mid-1990s computing revolution, the U.S. economy has exhibited several striking regularities. Labor productivity growth has slowed below its historical trend following a decade-long boom, while the labor share has declined. Computing technologies are characterized by rapid obsolescence, and U.S. data suggest that aggregate capital obsolescence has accelerated since their widespread adoption. I study the macroeconomic implications of this acceleration using an endogenous growth model in which the economy transitions to a new equilibrium with a higher obsolescence rate. As capital designs become obsolete sooner, the value of future payoffs to capital innovation initially falls. The economy responds with a temporary productivity boom driven by faster skill accumulation, which partially restores innovation profitability. Over time, however, efficient capital per efficient labor declines. Under factor complementarity, this scarcity depresses the labor share by raising flow profits accruing to capital designs relative to skills. Resources are redirected from skill creation toward short-lived capital innovation, ultimately slowing long-run growth. The calibrated model produces productivity and labor-share dynamics broadly consistent with the data, and the paper advances the obsolescence channel as one plausible account of these trends.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代中期计算革命以来，美国经济呈现出若干显著规律性特征。在经历长达十年的繁荣期后，劳动生产率增速已放缓至历史趋势线以下，同时劳动收入份额持续下降。计算技术具有快速过时的特性，美国数据表明，自其广泛普及以来，总体资本过时速度已显著加快。本文通过构建内生增长模型研究这一加速现象对宏观经济的影响，在该模型中经济将向具有更高过时率的新均衡状态过渡。随着资本设计过时速度加快，资本创新未来收益的现值最初出现下降。经济通过技能积累加速形成暂时性生产率繁荣作为应对，这在一定程度上恢复了创新盈利能力。然而，单位有效劳动的有效资本存量随时间推移持续下降。在要素互补性条件下，这种稀缺性通过提高资本设计相对于技能所获得的流动利润，压低了劳动收入份额。资源从技能创造转向短寿命资本创新，最终导致长期增长放缓。校准模型产生的生产率与劳动份额动态与数据基本吻合，本文提出过时渠道作为解释这些趋势的合理机制之一。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Technology overload? macroeconomic implications of accelerated obsolescence
title_zh: 技术过载？加速淘汰的宏观经济影响

abstract: This paper studies how investing in venture capital (VC) affects the entrepreneurial outcomes of individual limited partners (LPs). Using comprehensive administrative data on entrepreneurial activities and VC fundraising and investments in China, we find that after investing in a successfully launched VC fund, individual LPs create significantly more ventures than do LPs in funds that failed to launch. These new ventures tend to be high-tech firms with better employment outcomes and more patent activity. Our results suggest that venture investments are a channel through which individual LPs learn. (JEL D83, G23, G24, L25, L26)
abstract_zh: 本文研究风险资本（VC）投资如何影响个人有限合伙人（LP）的创业成果。利用中国创业活动及风险资本募资与投资的综合行政数据，我们发现，在投资于成功启动的风险资本基金后，个人有限合伙人创办的企业数量显著多于投资于未能成功启动基金的有限合伙人。这些新创企业多为高科技公司，具有更优的就业表现和更多的专利活动。研究结果表明，风险投资是个人有限合伙人学习的重要渠道。（JEL D83, G23, G24, L25, L26）
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Learning by Investing: Entrepreneurial Spillovers from Venture Capital
title_zh: 通过投资学习：风险投资的创业溢出效应

abstract: Why do some buyers contract directly with producers, while others contract via an intermediary that coordinates assignments and monitors performance? We develop a repeated-game model in which intermediaries aggregate fluctuating demand, lengthening productive relationships and making cooperation easier to sustain. This benefit comes at the cost of double marginalization: an added layer of rents is needed to motivate the intermediary. The trade-off determines which buyers rely on an intermediary and which contract directly. In equilibrium, producers working through intermediaries earn lower, less variable pay but greater job security. Intermediaries expand trade, yet shift its gains from producers to buyers. Managerial coordination also promotes specialization. The framework sheds new light on professional service firms, global sourcing intermediaries, and digital matching platforms.
abstract_zh: 为何部分买方直接与生产者签约，而另一些买方则通过协调任务分配并监督履约的中介机构进行签约？我们构建了一个重复博弈模型，其中中介机构通过整合波动的需求，延长生产关系的存续期，使合作更易维持。这一优势的代价是双重边际化：需要额外层级的租金来激励中介机构。这种权衡决定了哪些买方依赖中介机构、哪些买方直接签约。在均衡状态下，通过中介机构工作的生产者收入更低、波动性更小，但工作保障更高。中介机构扩大了贸易规模，却将贸易收益从生产者转移至买方。管理协调还促进了专业化分工。该框架为专业服务公司、全球采购中介及数字匹配平台提供了新的理论视角。
title: Managerial Coordination in Decentralized Markets
title_zh: 分散市场中的管理协调

abstract: This paper studies how social identification reshapes the political economy of law enforcement. In a two-class economy with property crime, individuals choose whether to offend, vote over the detection probability under majority rule, and choose whether to identify with their class or with the encompassing nation. In the absence of identity concerns, class-specific material preferences over enforcement depend on victimization exposure, tax incidence, and the option value of offending. With class identification, voters place greater weight on the relative payoff of their own group, so social identity amplifies the underlying distributive conflict. With national identification, voters place greater weight on aggregate payoffs, compressing preferred enforcement levels across groups. Endogenous identity choice produces distinct political regimes and can generate multiple equilibria: societies in which class differences are more salient in identity space are more likely to sustain class identification and more extreme enforcement outcomes, whereas higher national prestige favors national identification and policies closer to the aggregate benchmark. An extension in which offending carries an action-based social deviance cost preserves the main mechanism and shows how compliance norms can reinforce class-based identity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究社会认同如何重塑执法领域的政治经济学。在一个存在财产犯罪的两阶级经济体中，个体需选择是否犯罪、通过多数决规则投票决定犯罪侦破概率，并选择认同自身阶级或包容性国家。在缺乏身份认同的情况下，阶级间对执法的物质偏好差异取决于受害风险、税收负担及犯罪的机会成本。当存在阶级认同时，选民更重视本群体的相对收益，因此社会认同会加剧潜在的分配冲突。当存在国家认同时，选民更重视总体收益，从而压缩不同群体间的偏好执法水平。内生身份选择会产生不同的政治体制，并可能形成多重均衡：在身份空间中阶级差异更显著的社会，更易维持阶级认同并导致更极端的执法结果；而国家声望越高，则更有利于国家认同及更接近总体基准的政策。本文扩展模型引入基于行为的犯罪社会越轨成本，在保留核心机制的同时，揭示了合规规范如何强化阶级认同。
title: Social identification and equilibrium law enforcement
title_zh: 社会认同与均衡执法

abstract: This paper examines how social context affects consumption responses to transitory income shocks. Using a randomized survey experiment embedded in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we vary whether an unexpected €1,000 employer-specific bonus is observable to coworkers and whether it is received only by the respondent or by all coworkers. The design separately identifies the effect of observability for an idiosyncratic bonus and the incremental effect of making a publicly observable bonus common within the workplace, a well-defined social context. Making an idiosyncratic bonus publicly observable reduces the MPC by about 3 percentage points relative to a private idiosyncratic bonus. Conditional on observability, making the bonus common among coworkers raises the MPC by about 6 percentage points. Interpreted through a linear social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of approximately 0.16 and a social multiplier of about 1.2. These findings suggest that aggregate consumption responses to fiscal policy depend not only on individual behavior but also on the social context in which income changes occur.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨社会情境如何影响消费对暂时性收入冲击的反应。通过嵌入意大利消费者预期调查中的随机调查实验，我们改变了以下变量：一笔1000欧元雇主特定奖金是否被同事观察到，以及该奖金仅由受访者获得还是由所有同事共同获得。该实验设计分别识别了个人特定奖金的可观察性效应，以及将公开可观察奖金转化为工作场所共同奖金（一种明确界定的社会情境）的增量效应。相较于私人个人特定奖金，将个人特定奖金公开化会使边际消费倾向降低约3个百分点。在可观察性条件下，将奖金转化为同事共同奖金则使边际消费倾向提高约6个百分点。通过线性社会互动模型进行解释，后者效应意味着社会互动参数约为0.16，社会乘数约为1.2。这些发现表明，财政政策引发的总消费反应不仅取决于个体行为，还取决于收入变化发生时的社会情境。
title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
title_zh: 消费中的可观察性与社会互动

abstract: We use recent cross‐country experiences to assess the impact of shrinking central bank balance sheets through quantitative tightening (QT). QT announcements increase government bond yields, steepening the yield curve and potentially signaling a greater commitment to raising policy interest rates, but have more limited effects on most other financial market indicators. Active QT has a larger impact than passive QT, particularly on longer maturities. Increased demand by domestic nonbanks has largely compensated for reduced central bank bond holdings. Overall, QT has (to date) had more of an impact than “paint drying,” but far less than simply reversing the effects of quantitative easing programs.
abstract_zh: 我们利用近期跨国经验评估了通过量化紧缩（QT）缩减央行资产负债表的影响。QT公告推高了政府债券收益率，使收益率曲线陡峭化，并可能释放出更坚定加息的政策承诺信号，但对大多数其他金融市场指标的影响较为有限。主动型QT比被动型QT影响更大，尤其在长期限债券方面。国内非银行机构需求的增加在很大程度上弥补了央行债券持有量的减少。总体而言，QT（迄今为止）的影响远非“乏善可陈”，但远未达到简单逆转量化宽松政策效果的程度。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Quantitative Tightening Around the Globe: What Have We Learned?
title_zh: 全球量化紧缩：我们学到了什么？

abstract: This study investigates the impact of public data openness (PD) on venture capital investments. Our research design provides new evidence on how public data, as digital public goods, can serve as a policy instrument in public governance to promote venture capital investments by boosting regional trust and improving the business credit environment, both theoretically and empirically. We use data from 291 prefecture-level cities from 2009 to 2021 to examine the adoption of online public data platforms by local public sectors in China’s pilot cities. Using staggered Difference-in-Differences (DID) analyses, we find that public data platforms significantly increase the number of city-level venture capital investments. Our findings are also robust to a series of tests and checks for endogeneity, including dynamic DID, synthetic DID, matching, poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood estimation, alternative measures of VC, exclusion of other policies’ impacts, Bacon-Decomposition and Callaway and Sant’Anna estimator, and machine learning techniques. In additional analysis, we also verify that public data openness helps mitigate regional investment imbalances in venture capital. Our empirical findings indicate that public sectors should promote the openness of public data resources to generate greater positive externalities in regional development. KEYWORDS: Public data digital governance trust level venture capital investments JEL CLASSIFICATION: H70 R58 M21
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了公共数据开放（PD）对风险投资的影响。我们的研究设计从理论与实证层面提供了新证据，表明公共数据作为数字公共产品，能够通过提升区域信任水平、改善商业信用环境，成为公共治理中促进风险投资的政策工具。我们采用2009年至2021年中国291个地级市的数据，考察了试点城市地方公共部门对在线公共数据平台的采纳情况。通过交错双重差分（DID）分析，我们发现公共数据平台显著增加了城市层面的风险投资数量。该结论在一系列稳健性检验和内生性处理中依然成立，包括动态DID、合成DID、匹配法、泊松伪极大似然估计、风险投资的替代度量、排除其他政策影响、Bacon分解、Callaway与Sant'Anna估计量以及机器学习技术。进一步分析表明，公共数据开放有助于缓解区域间风险投资的不平衡。实证结果指出，公共部门应推动公共数据资源的开放，以在区域发展中产生更大的正外部性。关键词：公共数据 数字治理 信任水平 风险投资 JEL分类：H70 R58 M21

title: Public data openness and venture capital investments
title_zh: 公共数据开放与风险投资

abstract: This study investigates the dynamics of a community-based protected area management system in northeast Madagascar, addressing three key questions: What is the relationship between local livelihoods and the protected area? How do the management system’s use zones compare to forest cover dynamics on the ground? How could the forest management system be reformed to better support both local communities and forest ecosystems? We employ a mixed-methods approach, combining interviews and focus groups with local residents, a PlanetScope-based land cover classification, and a review of existing documentation. We find that the forest is important for rural livelihoods, yet the management system does not offer sufficient economic benefits to counteract the drivers of land cover change. These drivers include logging as a poverty alleviation strategy, forest clearing for vanilla cultivation, and the farming of staple food crops. While forest management is based on a biosphere model with different forest use zones, it does not reflect realities on the ground. Moving forward, initiatives must address internal and external drivers of forest cover change. Locally, the management model needs to better reflect present land cover, promote alternatives to forest use, and deliver concrete benefits to those who engage in forest conservation. The local community is open to stronger forest preservation, provided it is accompanied by a significant livelihood-supporting benefit. Regionally, strategies are needed to restrict land use by outsiders who often encroach on the forest to cultivate vanilla or harvest timber, and to strengthen coordination across local, regional, and national scales of forest governance.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了马达加斯加东北部社区型保护区管理系统的动态变化，围绕三个核心问题展开：当地生计与保护区之间存在何种关联？管理系统的功能分区与地面森林覆盖动态相比如何？森林管理系统应如何改革，以更好地兼顾当地社区与森林生态系统的需求？我们采用混合研究方法，结合当地居民的访谈与焦点小组讨论、基于PlanetScope影像的土地覆盖分类，以及现有文献资料的梳理。研究发现，森林对农村生计至关重要，然而现行管理系统未能提供足够的经济利益，以抵消土地覆盖变化的驱动因素。这些驱动因素包括作为减贫策略的伐木活动、为种植香草而进行的森林开垦，以及主粮作物的耕作。尽管森林管理基于生物圈模型并划分了不同的森林利用区域，但该模型并未反映实地真实情况。展望未来，相关举措必须应对森林覆盖变化的内外部驱动因素。在地方层面，管理模型需更贴合当前土地覆盖现状，推广森林利用的替代方案，并为参与森林保护的人员提供切实利益。当地社区愿意接受更严格的森林保护，前提是伴随显著的生计支持性收益。在区域层面，需制定策略限制外来者侵占森林用于香草种植或木材采伐的行为，并加强地方、区域及国家各级森林治理的协调联动。
title: Global conservation imaginaries and local realities: Rethinking community-based natural resources management in Northeast Madagascar
title_zh: 全球保护想象与地方现实：重新思考马达加斯加东北部基于社区的自然资源管理

abstract: Land governance in African countries often unfolds at the intersection of formal state institutions and informal traditional authority structures. In many communities, unelected traditional leaders and chiefs continue to wield substantial influence over land allocation and local dispute resolution, operating alongside elected officials. These patterns raise critical questions about how perceived government performance influences who governs key resources, such as land. Does a well-performing state crowd out the influence of traditional authorities, or does it create an environment where formal and informal actors collaborate for better outcomes? Our study investigates these issues, focusing on the role of chiefs in land distribution as a key outcome. We use the Afrobarometer dataset from 2021 to 2023 for 31 African countries in which traditional authorities govern rural and local communities. We conducted moderated mediation analyses using absorbed regression (AREG), logit, and wild-cluster linear regressions, accounting for country and broad regional-level fixed effects. We find that perceived government performance is positively associated with land governance. Traditional authority positively mediates the link between government performance and land governance. Furthermore, while disinformation attenuates the mediation effect, perceived responsiveness of traditional leaders amplifies this effect. Lastly, perceived institutional trust positively strengthens the traditional authority-land governance nexus. We ground our approach in an institutionalist perspective that views governance in Africa as the product of ongoing interactions between formal state structures and informal societal institutions. We further discuss the theoretical and practical findings, as well as major limitations and avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 非洲国家的土地治理往往发生在正式国家制度与非正式传统权力结构的交汇处。在许多社区，未经选举的传统领袖和酋长继续在土地分配和地方争端解决方面发挥重大影响力，与民选官员并行运作。这些现象引发了关于政府绩效感知如何影响关键资源（如土地）治理主体的关键问题。一个表现良好的国家是否会削弱传统权威的影响力，还是创造一个正式与非正式行为者协作以取得更好成果的环境？本研究聚焦于酋长在土地分配中的作用这一关键结果，探讨上述问题。我们使用2021至2023年间31个非洲国家的Afrobarometer数据集，这些国家的传统权威治理着农村和地方社区。我们采用吸收回归（AREG）、logit和wild-cluster线性回归进行有调节的中介分析，并纳入国家和广泛区域层面的固定效应。研究发现，政府绩效感知与土地治理呈正相关。传统权威在政府绩效与土地治理之间起正向中介作用。此外，虚假信息削弱了中介效应，而传统领袖的回应性感知则增强了这一效应。最后，制度信任感知正向强化了传统权威与土地治理之间的关联。我们的研究基于制度主义视角，将非洲治理视为正式国家结构与非正式社会制度之间持续互动的产物。我们进一步讨论了理论与实践发现、主要局限性及未来研究方向。
title: How government performance, informational environment, trust, and traditional authority shape local land governance in Africa
title_zh: 政府绩效、信息环境、信任与传统权威如何塑造非洲地方土地治理

abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases—such as clustered exposure—and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.
abstract_zh: 本文研究用于估计溢出效应的实验最优设计与分析方法。在已知（例如线性）暴露映射的假设下，我们刻画了能够最小化针对广泛不可观测变量分布的最坏情况渐近方差——该方差由处理分配分布与基于回归的估计量共同决定。设计问题给出了一个直观解：规划者需在溢出信号强度与溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题则产生一个简单的中心化工具变量估计量，以最优方式利用该变异。该框架在若干基准情形（如聚类暴露）中提供了自然解，并为一般网络（包括二分图设定）提出了计算上可处理的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学的两个应用案例，通过半合成实验展示了这些新工具。在两个实验中，我们的方法均大幅降低了标准误，使有效样本量提升50%-100%或更多。
title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
title_zh: 溢出效应实验中的稳健信号最大化

abstract: In theories of creative destruction, product innovation is a key driver of aggregate growth. This paper confronts the predictions of these theories about product dynamics with empirical patterns in product-level data on French manufacturing firms. We find that the process of product innovation frequently exhibits bursts—episodes in which firms rapidly add multiple products to their portfolio. As a result, 5% of firms are responsible for over 76% of product creation. Bursts lead to substantial shifts in revenue, and the process of product creation and destruction explains 88% of the variance in five-year firm growth. We introduce a model of firm product innovation that is compatible with the data while also nesting the canonical models of creative destruction. We show that innovation bursts alter the equilibrium composition of age, size, and innovation efficiency of firms, and explain the concentration of production among superstar firms. Our model thus enables the joint study of the determinants of industry concentration and growth in a setting consistent with the empirical patterns of product dynamics.
abstract_zh: 在创造性破坏理论中，产品创新是总体增长的关键驱动力。本文将这些理论关于产品动态的预测与法国制造业企业产品层面数据的实证模式进行对比。我们发现，产品创新过程经常呈现爆发式特征——即企业快速向产品组合中添加多种产品的阶段。由此，5%的企业贡献了超过76%的新产品创造。产品创新爆发导致收入发生显著变化，而产品创造与淘汰过程解释了企业五年增长差异的88%。我们构建了一个与企业数据兼容且嵌套经典创造性破坏模型的企业产品创新模型。研究表明，创新爆发改变了企业年龄、规模和创新效率的均衡构成，并解释了超级明星企业生产集中度的形成。因此，本模型能够在与产品动态实证模式一致的框架下，联合研究行业集中度与增长的决定因素。
title: Creative Destruction through Innovation Bursts
title_zh: 创新爆发中的创造性破坏

abstract: With the rapid development of China’s FinTech, this study considers China as an example to explore the impact of FinTech on vertical integration in developing countries. The research results reveal the following. First, the development of FinTech has significantly increased vertical integration, indicating that FinTech can enhance the security of industrial and supply chains. Second, such development has reduced the information asymmetry between banks and enterprises and alleviated the financing constraints of enterprises. Third, it has also improved the digital management level of enterprises and enhanced their internal governance ability. Fourth, FinTech is more conducive to increasing vertical integration in private enterprises, smaller enterprises, start-up and growth-stage enterprises, high-tech industry enterprises, and export enterprises. KEYWORDS: FinTech vertical integration financing constraints internal governance ability JEL CLASSIFICATION: G30 L22 O14
abstract_zh: 随着中国金融科技的快速发展，本研究以中国为例，探讨金融科技对发展中国家纵向整合的影响。研究结果揭示如下：第一，金融科技的发展显著提升了纵向整合水平，表明金融科技能够增强产业链与供应链的安全性。第二，这种发展降低了银行与企业之间的信息不对称，缓解了企业的融资约束。第三，金融科技还提高了企业的数字化管理水平，增强了其内部治理能力。第四，金融科技更有利于提升民营企业、小型企业、初创及成长期企业、高科技行业企业以及出口企业的纵向整合程度。关键词：金融科技 纵向整合 融资约束 内部治理能力 JEL分类：G30 L22 O14

title: FinTech and vertical integration in emerging economies: evidence from China
title_zh: 金融科技与新兴经济体的垂直整合：来自中国的证据

abstract: This article examines how parental co-residence in the destination city is related to migrants’ labour supply. Using the 2018 China Migrants Dynamic Survey, the results show that parental co-residence is positively associated with migrants’ weekly working hours, and this relationship is mainly driven by relatively younger co-residing parents. To interpret the mechanism, the paper develops and estimates a structural time-allocation framework in which parents can substitute for household tasks but may also generate coordination costs within multigenerational households. The structural estimates suggest that parental assistance releases time for market work, while co-residence frictions partly offset these gains. Policy simulations further suggest that reducing household task burdens through market and community services may generate more stable labour-supply gains than relying only on family-based support. By linking empirical evidence with a structural time-allocation framework, this article contributes to the literature by showing that family support in migrant households is valuable but not costless, because parental co-residence simultaneously relaxes household task burdens and creates co-residence frictions. KEYWORDS: Migration labour supply intergenerational co-residence time allocation JEL CLASSIFICATION: J12 J13 J21 J22 J60
abstract_zh: 本文考察了父母在迁入地同住如何影响流动人口的劳动供给。基于2018年中国流动人口动态监测调查数据，研究发现父母同住与流动人口周工作小时数呈正相关，且这一关系主要由相对年轻的同住父母驱动。为解释其作用机制，本文构建并估计了一个结构性时间配置框架，在该框架中，父母可替代家务劳动，但也可能在多代同住家庭中产生协调成本。结构性估计结果表明，父母协助释放了市场劳动时间，但同住摩擦部分抵消了这些收益。政策模拟进一步显示，通过市场与社区服务减少家务负担，可能比单纯依赖家庭支持带来更稳定的劳动供给增益。通过将经验证据与结构性时间配置框架相结合，本文揭示了流动人口家庭中的家庭支持虽具价值但并非无成本——父母同住既缓解了家务负担，也产生了同住摩擦。关键词：迁移 劳动供给 代际同住 时间配置 JEL分类：J12 J13 J21 J22 J60
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用2018年中国流动人口动态调查数据，核心分析中国流动家庭中的父母同住与劳动供给关系，研究对象、数据及政策背景均明确指向中国。
title: Help comes with friction: parental Co-residence and labour supply in migrant households
title_zh: 帮助伴随摩擦：流动家庭中的父母同住与劳动供给

abstract: How reliable is historical microdata? Understanding historical labor force participation is crucial for assessing long-term trends in economic development and intergenerational mobility. Most existing historical studies are, however, limited to men, and little is known about how reliable quantitative historical sources are when studying labor market outcomes for women. This paper documents that the measurement of women’s economic activity in the 1910 Norwegian population census had a high level of consistency. There is extensive discussion of measurement issues in historical census reports, micro data can reproduce historical census tables with a high degree of accuracy, and other contemporary reports such as industrial censuses and tax statistics confirm the results found in the census. In addition, a double-enumeration feature of the Norwegian census is leveraged to assess consistency between enumerators, finding no indication that precision in the occupational classification of women is any lower than for men. Some potential sources of downward bias are found in the historical census microdata set provided by IPUMS. Based on the results in this paper, historical census data appears well suited to study economic activity using modern econometric methods, for women as well as men. A slight upward revision of the 39% female labor force participation in Norway in 1910 might be in order.
abstract_zh: 历史微观数据的可靠性如何？理解历史劳动力参与率对于评估经济发展和代际流动的长期趋势至关重要。然而，现有的大多数历史研究仅限于男性，关于定量历史资料在研究女性劳动力市场结果时的可靠性知之甚少。本文记录了1910年挪威人口普查中女性经济活动测量的高度一致性。历史普查报告中对测量问题有广泛讨论，微观数据能够高度准确地重现历史普查表格，而其他当代报告如工业普查和税收统计也证实了普查中的结果。此外，利用挪威普查的双重登记特性来评估普查员之间的一致性，未发现女性职业分类的精确度低于男性的迹象。在IPUMS提供的历史普查微观数据集中发现了一些潜在的下行偏差来源。基于本文的结果，历史普查数据似乎非常适合使用现代计量经济学方法研究经济活动，无论是对女性还是男性。对1910年挪威39%的女性劳动力参与率进行轻微上调可能是合适的。
title: Female labor force participation in historical census microdata
title_zh: 历史人口普查微观数据中的女性劳动力参与

abstract: This study investigates how target-based performance evaluation affects the spatial allocation of environmental enforcement. Using China’s ambient air quality monitoring network as a quasi-experimental setting, we combine high-frequency firm-level emissions data and a difference-in-differences design. We document a 12.6% reduction in nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions among polluting firms located near newly established monitoring stations, relative to more distant firms. This disparity reveals a strategic reallocation of enforcement effort by local governments to improve visible air quality metrics tied to career incentives, rather than to achieve broad pollution abatement. While such selective enforcement helps jurisdictions meet top-down performance targets, it creates a “monitoring-proximity paradox,” whereby regulatory effort becomes spatially concentrated.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了基于目标的绩效评估如何影响环境执法的空间配置。以中国环境空气质量监测网络为准自然实验场景，我们结合高频企业级排放数据与双重差分模型展开分析。研究发现，相较于距离较远的企业，新建监测站点周边污染企业的氮氧化物排放量下降了12.6%。这一差异揭示了地方政府为改善与职业晋升激励挂钩的显性空气质量指标，而非实现广泛污染减排所采取的策略性执法资源再配置行为。尽管这种选择性执法有助于辖区完成自上而下的绩效目标，却形成了"监测邻近悖论"——即监管力度呈现空间集聚特征。
china_relevance_reason: AI 倾向判定为中国相关，但题名/摘要/元数据缺少直接中国证据，已按保守规则排除
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Strategic Enforcement Distortion Under Target-Based Environmental Governance: Spatial Heterogeneity in Pollution Mitigation and Policy Implications
title_zh: 目标导向环境治理下的策略性执法扭曲：污染减排的空间异质性与政策启示

abstract: Accurately estimating the Phillips curve remains a significant methodological challenge. Recent panel data approaches reveal substantial cross-sectional heterogeneity, raising doubts about pooled estimates. This paper develops a novel group-based approach that systematically accounts for unobserved heterogeneity in the regional Phillips curve. We identify two distinct groups of U.S. states: one with a steep, significant Phillips curve, and another with a flat, insignificant relationship. Our results show that regional heterogeneity persists across regimes, with parameter nonlinearity emerging during recessions. Much of the flattening of the Phillips curve is region-specific, indicating the importance of both heterogeneity and nonlinearity in Phillips curve dynamics.
abstract_zh: 准确估计菲利普斯曲线仍是一项重大的方法论挑战。近期面板数据方法揭示了显著的横截面异质性，引发了对合并估计的质疑。本文开发了一种新颖的基于分组的方法，系统性地考虑了区域菲利普斯曲线中的未观测异质性。我们识别出两组不同的美国州：一组具有陡峭且显著的菲利普斯曲线，另一组则呈现平坦且不显著的关系。我们的结果显示，区域异质性在不同制度下持续存在，参数非线性在经济衰退期间显现。菲利普斯曲线的大部分平坦化现象具有区域特定性，表明异质性和非线性在菲利普斯曲线动态中的重要性。
title: Dissecting the Phillips curve: Evidence from cross-sectional heterogeneity and regime-dependent nonlinearity
title_zh: 剖析菲利普斯曲线：来自横截面异质性与体制依赖非线性的证据

abstract: Characterized by its predatory nature and the institutional uncertainty, rentier resource nationalism (RRN) has emerged as a critical risk factor for overseas investment by multinational corporations (MNCs). However, existing literature rarely relies on theoretical models to analyze the differential impacts of RRN across heterogeneous investment objectives. Furthermore, the underlying role of resource value remains underexplored, particularly from the perspective of “cognitive divergence”. To address these gaps, this study develops a three-stage game model and investigates how RRN and resource value affect the economic variables of MNCs. The results reveal that RRN significantly reduces the residual profit and overseas investment outlay of MNCs, while increasing metal output. Through the lens of investment objective heterogeneity, MNCs targeting residual profit maximization suffer negative shocks. Conversely, MNCs aiming to ensure more resource supply can benefit from the dynamics, and exhibit a higher tolerance threshold for RRN intensity. The ultimate impact of resource value hinges on the relative strength of the market-size driving effect versus the resource-depletion inhibitory effect. Crucially, “cognitive divergence” regarding resource value serves as an important mechanism explaining the simultaneous emergence of intensified RRN and the expansion of investment outlay. This study provides a theoretical foundation for the rational formulation of RRN policies and enriches the theoretical framework of international investment.
abstract_zh: 以掠夺性特征和制度不确定性为特征的租金型资源民族主义（RRN），已成为跨国公司（MNCs）海外投资的关键风险因素。然而，现有文献鲜有基于理论模型分析RRN对不同投资目标异质性影响的差异。此外，资源价值的基础性作用仍未得到充分探讨，尤其是从“认知分歧”的视角来看。为弥补上述研究空白，本研究构建了一个三阶段博弈模型，考察RRN与资源价值如何影响跨国公司的经济变量。研究结果显示，RRN显著降低了跨国公司的剩余利润与海外投资支出，同时提高了金属产出。从投资目标异质性的视角来看，以剩余利润最大化为目标的跨国公司遭受负面冲击；相反，旨在保障更多资源供应的跨国公司则能从这一动态中获益，并对RRN强度表现出更高的容忍阈值。资源价值的最终影响取决于市场规模驱动效应与资源耗竭抑制效应的相对强弱。关键在于，关于资源价值的“认知分歧”是解释RRN加剧与投资支出扩张同时出现的重要机制。本研究为RRN政策的合理制定提供了理论基础，并丰富了国际投资的理论框架。
title: Rentier resource nationalism and overseas investment by multinational corporations: the impact of resource value
title_zh: 租金资源民族主义与跨国企业海外投资：资源价值的影响

abstract: Artificial intelligence is already reshaping the economy and society. This column analyses how AI affects firms, markets, and workers using 380 trillion tokens of realised AI consumption. It calculates the sensitivity of stocks to growth in AI use and estimates a premium capturing how the equity market values that sensitivity. Firms with higher sensitivity earn higher subsequent returns. The AI premium is highest for developed markets, frontier models, experienced users, and complex tasks. Equity markets furthermore associate the AI transition more positively with work involving implementation, communication, and coordination than with analytical and scientific tasks.
abstract_zh: 人工智能正在重塑经济与社会。本文基于380万亿个已实现的人工智能消费标记，分析了人工智能如何影响企业、市场与劳动者。研究计算了股票对人工智能使用增长的敏感度，并估算了股票市场对该敏感度定价的溢价。敏感度较高的企业后续获得了更高的回报。人工智能溢价在发达市场、前沿模型、经验丰富的用户以及复杂任务中最为显著。此外，相较于分析与科学类任务，股票市场将人工智能转型与涉及实施、沟通和协调的工作更积极地关联起来。
authors: Nicola Borri, Yukun Liu, Aleh Tsyvinski
title: The AI premium
title_zh: 人工智能溢价

abstract: Quantitative easing has faced recent criticism for causing large central bank losses and contributing to the post-COVID inflation, raising the question of under what conditions it may be warranted as a tool to fight recessions. This column employs a model that allows for an empirically realistic account of the key transmission mechanisms of quantitative easing and finds significant macroeconomic and fiscal benefits of using it to fight recessions when inflation is expected to remain well below the central bank’s target for a protracted period. However, there is reason for caution when deploying it in shallow recessions where it runs more risk of causing the economy to overheat.
abstract_zh: 量化宽松政策近期因导致央行巨额亏损及助长疫情后通胀而受到批评，这引发了一个问题：在何种条件下，该政策可作为应对衰退的合理工具。本文采用了一个能够对量化宽松关键传导机制进行符合实证现实的建模分析，发现当通胀预期将在较长时间内持续远低于央行目标时，运用量化宽松应对衰退可带来显著的宏观经济与财政效益。然而，在浅度衰退中部署该政策需保持谨慎，因其更易引发经济过热风险。
authors: Tobias Adrian, Marcin Kolasa, Christopher Erceg, Jesper Lindé, Pawel Zabczyk
title: Rethinking the use of quantitative easing for macro stimulus
title_zh: 重新思考量化宽松用于宏观刺激的作用

abstract: We leverage a sharp 2012 parking fine increase for failing to purchase vehicle registration to examine disparate ticketing patterns across enforcement agencies in Chicago. Using an event-study framework, we find that Chicago police increased their enforcement of car registration non-compliance in Black relative to non-Black neighborhoods, with no observed disparate response from non-police enforcement agencies. This disparity is unexplained by compliance and is instead driven by departmental revenue incentives and multitasking-driven lower marginal search costs in Black neighborhoods. Disparate enforcement also exacerbated existing gaps in financial instability, generating increased rates of ticket non-payment and bankruptcy filings in Black neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2012年芝加哥对未购买车辆注册的停车罚款大幅上调这一事件，考察不同执法机构间开罚单模式的差异。通过事件研究框架，我们发现芝加哥警方在黑人相对非黑人社区加强了对车辆注册违规的执法力度，而非警方执法机构则未表现出类似的差异化反应。这种差异无法用合规性解释，而是源于部门收入激励及多任务处理导致的在黑人社区较低的边际搜索成本。差异化执法还加剧了既有的财务不稳定差距，导致黑人社区罚单未支付率和破产申请率上升。
title: Agency incentives and disparate revenue collection: Evidence from Chicago parking tickets
title_zh: 代理激励与差异化税收征管：来自芝加哥停车罚单的证据

abstract: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。
title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
title_zh: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起

abstract: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.
abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。
title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据

abstract: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。
title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距

abstract: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。
title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用

abstract: The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。
title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应

abstract: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。
title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选

abstract: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.
abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。
title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

abstract: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。
title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术

abstract: We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。
title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策

abstract: Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.
abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。
title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

abstract: This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。
title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态

abstract: We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究具有以下特征的工具变量模型：（i）未观测异质性由潜在结果和描述工具如何决定处理选择的响应类型构成；（ii）工具与未观测异质性条件独立；（iii）未观测异质性分布满足凸性约束。我们证明，当且仅当Abadie（2003）的kappa统计量存在时，这些模型中的某些因果参数可被识别。我们的识别结果是建设性的，能够导出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本开发了渐近正态估计量。
title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
title_zh: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie's Kappa的核心作用
